card.name: Clotting test names like PT and aPTT
card.fires_on: The last piece of a clotting test name, such as time in prothrombin time, PT, or the final T of aPTT. It appears in anticoagulant monitoring text for warfarin and heparin.

modes.label: Prothrombin time
modes.description: The word time or the abbreviation PT after prothrombin, in warfarin monitoring lines.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Warfarin: Carefully monitor prothrombin<< time>> (PT) and International Normalized Ratio

modes.label: aPTT ending
modes.description: The final T of aPTT or APTT, in heparin or argatroban monitoring.
modes.example: Adjust heparin to maintain APT<<T>> of 60 to 85
